newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two Mexico crude ports expected to close soon.
newsitem.headline: Two Mexico crude ports expected to close soon.

text.p: Officials at Mexico's Dos Bocas and Pajaritos crude ports said late Wednesday the ports could close later in the night or early in the morning.

The ports were closed to smaller tourist and fishing boats by 1830 local/0030 GMT as wind speeds in the northern gulf of Mexico increased to between 45 and 55 km per hour. If wind speeds continue to rise the ports could shut to petroleum exports, the officials said.
A cold front in the region closed ports Tampico and Altamira in Tamaulipas state and Tuxpan in Veracruz state, and was expected to continue to move down the coast with light rains.

The Communications and Transport Ministry warned in its daily meteorological bulletin that ships should exercise caution along the coasts of Tamaulipas and Veracruz because of strong waves and high waves.
La Pesca, El Mezquital, Veracruz and Nautla ports were closed to smaller boats because of the bad weather, the ministry said.
